The single source for the runtime <Seo/> component (src/ui/Seo.tsx) and the build-time prerender (scripts/seo-prerender.mjs), which writes per-page HTML, sitemap.xml and robots.txt into dist/. Only paths listed under pages are indexable; every other route is served noindex. Hubs are never indexed here: a customer's Hub is its own, and listing is the Discover feature's job.

pages.title: LunchVoice: anonymous surveys and polls for any community
pages.description: Build a survey in minutes, share it by QR code or a six-character code, and see anonymous, privacy-safe results live. Free Quick Surveys; Hubs for communities from $13/month.
pages.h1: Every voice has a story. Hear it.
pages.body: LunchVoice is a community feedback platform. Build a survey in minutes, share it with one QR code or a six-character code, and watch anonymous answers arrive while it is still happening. Every community gets its own Hub at lunchvoice.com/yourname, with members, roles, pages and Campaigns: surveys, polls, ratings and open feedback. Answering is always free.

pages.title: How it works: Quick Surveys, Hubs and private results
pages.description: Ask with a free Quick Survey or give your community a Hub. Campaigns move from draft to scheduled to open to closed, and results show totals only, with small groups withheld.
pages.body: Ask with a Quick Survey: up to 5 active surveys of up to 10 questions, shared by link, QR code, a six-character code or invite links. Or give your community a Hub with members, roles, pages and Campaigns. Results show totals only; a group too small to stay anonymous is withheld, and a withheld value is never shown as zero.

pages.title: LunchVoice products: feedback, Hubs, Discord and API
pages.description: Everything LunchVoice does, in six parts: free feedback tools, Hubs for your community, Campaigns for your members, Discord, an API, and privacy built into every answer.
pages.body: Ask with free surveys, polls, ratings and open feedback. Give your community a Hub at its own address, run Campaigns for your members, post them to Discord, run it all from the API, and keep anonymous answers anonymous.

pages.title: Use cases: surveys for clubs, teams, events and work
pages.description: Anonymous surveys, polls, ratings and suggestion boxes for clubs, teams, events, workplaces, dining programs and neighbourhoods, where the answer matters and the respondent stays protected.
pages.body: Anything a group needs to ask, answer and settle: event feedback, team pulse checks, club votes, workplace surveys, dining and menu ratings, neighbourhood suggestion boxes. The answer matters, and the respondent is never exposed.

pages.title: Pricing: free Quick Surveys, Hubs from $13/month
pages.description: Answering is always free and Quick Surveys are free for anyone signed in. Starter Hub $13/month, Team Hub $29/month, Campaign Starter from $19 and Campaign Plus from $39 for time-bounded Campaigns.
pages.h1: Free to ask. Pay when you need a home.
pages.body: Free Quick Survey: $0. Campaign Starter: $19 for the first 2 weeks, then $13 per extra week. Campaign Plus: $39 for the first 2 weeks, then $19 per extra week. Starter Hub: $13 per month. Team Hub: $29 per month. Reserve your Hub URL: $25 per 12 months.

pages.title: Join the waitlist: 50 Founding Hub seats
pages.description: LunchVoice opens through a waitlist. The first 50 people admitted receive a Founding Hub credit. Join to claim your community's Hub address.
pages.body: LunchVoice opens through a waitlist. The first 50 admitted people receive a Founding Hub credit, so their community gets a Hub at lunchvoice.com/yourname on us.

pages.title: About: a community feedback platform that keeps promises
pages.description: LunchVoice by KpnSolute builds Quick Surveys, Hubs, Campaigns and privacy-safe results for clubs, teams, events, workplaces and neighbourhoods.
pages.body: LunchVoice by KpnSolute exists because most feedback tools ask people to trust a policy, then publish numbers that quietly identify them. We build Quick Surveys, Hubs, Campaigns and privacy-safe results.

pages.title: Discover public community Hubs
pages.description: A directory of large public LunchVoice Hubs that chose to be found. Hubs are listed after reaching 700 genuine active members on the Team plan.
pages.body: A directory of large public Hubs that chose to be found. Hubs appear only after they reach 700 genuine active members on the Team plan and are approved.

pages.title: Support and contact
pages.description: Get help with LunchVoice surveys, Hubs and accounts, or report a problem with a survey.
pages.body: Questions about a survey, a Hub or your account? Write to admin@lunchvoice.com.

pages.title: Privacy
pages.description: What LunchVoice stores, what anonymous means, who can see stored data, how long it is kept, and how to delete your account.
pages.body: Anonymous means the creator cannot resolve who answered. Eligibility is checked apart from the answer, and results show totals only.

pages.title: Terms
pages.description: The plain-language terms for using LunchVoice: privacy as a product constraint, plans and cancellation, and reporting abuse.
pages.body: Using LunchVoice, privacy as a product constraint, plans and cancellation, and reporting abuse.

pages.title: Community Guidelines
pages.description: The rules for Hubs, surveys, comments and shops on LunchVoice: respect people, respect anonymity, ask honestly and keep it legal.
pages.body: Respect people, respect anonymity, ask honestly, keep it legal and safe, no spam, protect other people's information.
